When it merges, compare the frozen base-to-head diff with the final upstream change, reconcile amendments, verify startup and shutdown with a foreign handler on the Serve port, then clear the snapshot marker with that intake. If it closes without merging, review whether to remove the change or retain it as maintained fork behavior and record that decision before clearing the marker.

Imported provisionally as one snapshot: cancelling an incoming-share task picker discards its durable inbox entry, so it stays dismissed after relaunch and identical content can be shared again. The fork retains its Stack imports and layout, documents the discard retry dependency, and adds a cancellation/relaunch regression while preserving attachment ownership checks. When it merges, compare the frozen base-to-head diff with the final upstream change, reconcile amendments and fork adaptations, verify cancellation, relaunch, re-sharing, and a route covering the picker, then clear the snapshot marker with that intake. If it closes without merging, review whether to remove the change or retain it as maintained fork behavior and record that decision before clearing the marker.

Replaces #13914, which upstream closed after the fork imported it early from its unmerged commits: puts keyboard focus back in the app after an agent click in a preview tab. Same host-side approach; it also restores focus when the click fails and hands focus between overlapping clicks. When the queue reaches it, reconcile the #13914 import with it and take upstream's version. Known gap from that import to recheck then: a person clicking into the page during an agent click gets focus moved back to the composer, because the interruption check reads an error tag that desktop IPC does not carry.
